title: rosa × dumetorum subvar. hispidula
intro: Rosa × dumetorum subvar. hispidula, commonly known as Rosa hispidula, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is a type of wild rose that is native to North America. Rosa hispidula has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties that can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and swelling, and calm the nervous system. The plant's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
